campaign.title: Agentic Engineering with Lotus
campaign.subtitle: A Producer's Quest Log
campaign.tagline: Every quest weakens the Friction. Every defeated quest is parallel work unlocked.

boss.name: FRICTION
boss.title: The Devourer of Producer Hours
boss.description: The ancient force that turns strategy into status-chasing, that makes plans go stale, that buries ICs in 'what am I doing today.' Slain not by force, but by skills, agents, and clarity.

phases.name: UNTOUCHED
phases.description: Producers compile plans by hand. ICs hunt for context. Risks surface at retro.

phases.name: WOUNDED
phases.description: Skills exist and get used. Brain is the source of truth. Plans drift less.

phases.name: BLEEDING
phases.description: First agents run autonomously. Status syncs without human intervention.

phases.name: STAGGERED
phases.description: Spec → ticket pipeline is automatic. Sprint plans pre-drafted.

phases.name: CORNERED
phases.description: ICs get personal daily briefs. Cross-pod coordination is continuous.

phases.name: DEFEATED
phases.description: Producers think. Agents synchronize. Engineers run 10+ parallel terminals as standard practice.

party.name: The Brain (Lotus Doc Brain)
party.note: Charter v1 stable. Source of truth for planning.

party.name: Ally Producer
party.note: Recruit one producer who buys the vision. Critical for survival.

party.name: Status Sync Agent
party.note: Unlocks after Phase 0 maturity gate is built.

party.name: Sprint Pipeline Agent
party.note: The dangerous one. Last to deploy. Writes to ClickUp.

party.name: Risk/Drift Agent
party.note: Watches everything. Surfaces nothing without reason.

chapters.title: Chapter I — Foundations
chapters.subtitle: Sharpen the Blade
chapters.description: Before we hunt the boss, we forge our weapons. Skills mature, processes harden, infrastructure constraints get answered.

quests.title: Forge the Maturity Gate
quests.description: Author the Skill Maturity Framework as a real document in the brain. Seven criteria, explicit bar, examples of pass and fail.
quests.frictionUnlock: Without this, every promotion to autonomous is a vibe call. Producers can't review skills consistently. Engineers can't trust agent output.

quests.title: Audit the Skill Armory
quests.description: Run every existing skill through the Maturity Framework. Tag each: agent-ready, needs-work, manual-forever. Output: a ranked list.
quests.frictionUnlock: We stop guessing which skills are ready. The next agent we wrap is the obvious one.

quests.title: Solve the Always-On Riddle
quests.description: Within the Fortis ecosystem, identify how scheduled/autonomous agents will actually run. Survey available tooling: existing CI runners, scheduled jobs, cloud functions, internal automation platforms. Produce a concrete proposal with one primary path and one fallback.
quests.frictionUnlock: This is the real boss-hp drain. Without an answer, no agent runs autonomously. With an answer, the floor opens.

quests.title: Enshrine the Where-Things-Live Edict
quests.description: Single-page, team-facing doc: which tool for which thing. Notion vs Brain vs ClickUp. Pin it in Slack. Reference it constantly until it's reflex.
quests.frictionUnlock: The most common drift on these efforts is people putting the right thing in the wrong tool. This is cheap, high-leverage.

quests.title: Build the Skill Review Ritual
quests.description: Define the lightweight review pipeline: skill proposed → drafted → tested by 2+ producers → reviewed against Maturity Framework → approved or sent back. Same pipeline for planning doc changes.
quests.frictionUnlock: Without a review ritual, skill quality drifts. With it, agent-ready becomes a real checkpoint we can trust.

quests.title: Recruit the First Ally
quests.description: Find one other producer who genuinely buys the vision. Not as a courtesy — as a co-champion. Walk them through the roadmap, get their pushback, fold it in.
quests.deliverable: An ally who can speak to this in rooms you're not in
quests.frictionUnlock: A solo champion is fragile. An ally turns this from one person's project into a small movement.

chapters.title: Chapter II — The Skill Forge
chapters.subtitle: Build What's Missing
chapters.description: We have skills. We're missing skills. The audit told us what to build. We build them.

quests.title: Skill: /clarity-audit
quests.description: Reads active sprint tickets in ClickUp. Checks each for: description, feature link, prioritization, clear 'why'. Outputs a per-owner report grouped by gap type.
quests.frictionUnlock: First skill that directly serves IC clarity. Producer-invokable today, agent-wrappable when mature. The seed of the future Clarity Auditor agent.

quests.title: Skill: /dependency-map-sync
quests.description: Reads cross-pod dependencies from feature specs and pod plans. Maintains dependency_map.md as a live surface. Flags dependencies at risk based on owner status + ClickUp progress.
quests.frictionUnlock: Replaces half the value of scrum-of-scrums. When this is live and trusted, we can cut a meeting.

quests.title: Skill: /risk-surface
quests.description: Continuous-mode version of /risk-evaluation. Lightweight, fast, designed to run on every plan change. Outputs deltas: new risks, resolved risks, escalating risks.
quests.frictionUnlock: Risks today surface at retro. With this, they surface within 48 hours of emergence.

quests.title: Skill: /spec-to-tickets
quests.description: Takes an approved feature spec and drafts the ClickUp ticket breakdown. Includes context, validation goal links, dependency callouts. Output is reviewable markdown; ticket creation is a separate gated step.
quests.frictionUnlock: The biggest manual handoff in current production becomes a 10-minute review. Engineers see context they couldn't see before.

quests.title: Skill: /ic-daily-brief
quests.description: Producer-invokable per-IC brief generator. Reads ClickUp + brain. Outputs: today's task, the feature it serves, validation goal, who else is on related work, blockers. Markdown today, future-Slack-DM later.
quests.frictionUnlock: Test the daily-brief format manually before agent-wrapping it. If ICs find it useful when sent by hand, it's ready for automation.

quests.title: Skill: /standup-prebrief
quests.description: Generates the pod's standup pre-brief: yesterday's progress (ClickUp deltas), today's focus, blockers, upcoming dependencies. Producer posts manually until agent-ready.
quests.frictionUnlock: Standups become decision meetings, not status meetings. Cuts standup time, increases standup value.

quests.title: Skill: /milestone-checkpoint
quests.description: Monthly milestone health summary. Reads product_targets, validation roadmap, feature roadmap, capacity. Output: are we on track for the milestone, what's at risk, what trade-offs are emerging.
quests.frictionUnlock: Currently this is hours of manual compilation per month. Becomes a 30-min review of pre-compiled data.

chapters.title: Chapter III — First Blood
chapters.subtitle: The Metagame Pilot
chapters.description: One pod. One agent. Read-only first. Earn trust before any agent writes.
chapters.lockedReason: Requires Always-On Riddle solved (q1-3) and at least 2 skills Phase-0 ready

quests.title: Deploy Status Sync Agent (Read-Only)
quests.description: First autonomous agent. Pulls ClickUp + SHQ Tracker on schedule. Updates brain's generated/ surfaces. Read-only — no writes back to source systems. Pilot pod: Metagame.
quests.deliverable: Status Sync Agent running on the always-on infra
quests.frictionUnlock: First time the brain stays fresh without a human running a skill. First slice of autonomous trust.

quests.title: Deploy Plan Coherence Agent
quests.description: Second autonomous agent. Watches plan deltas, fires risk-evaluation, surfaces options when capacity/dependencies shift. Surface-only. Metagame pod.
quests.frictionUnlock: Risks now surface continuously. The 'we discovered at retro' failure mode dies.

quests.title: Deploy Clarity Auditor Agent
quests.description: Runs the clarity-audit skill on a daily cadence. Pings owners (Slack DM) on gaps. Producer reviews weekly summary.
quests.frictionUnlock: ICs stop hitting Monday morning with 'why am I doing this?' tickets. Producer reclaims the chasing time.

quests.title: Build the Observability Hall
quests.description: Build the 'what did the agents do today?' dashboard. Audit log per agent, per run. Cost tracking. Failure tracking. The thing producers check when something feels off.
quests.frictionUnlock: Without observability, every agent failure becomes 'why don't we just do this manually.' With it, failures are diagnosable, fixable, and survivable.

chapters.title: Chapter IV — The Writing Hand
chapters.subtitle: Agents That Change Things
chapters.description: Read-only is safe. Read-write is where the leverage lives. Approval gates everywhere, trust earned per workflow.
chapters.lockedReason: Requires Chapter III complete and trust earned on read-only agents

quests.title: Deploy Spec Curator Agent
quests.description: First write-capable agent. Watches Notion, syncs spec changes to brain, flags gaps to designer queue. Writes only to brain — never to Notion or ClickUp.
quests.frictionUnlock: Specs and plans stay in sync without human ferrying. Designers get gap-pings within hours, not weeks.

quests.title: Deploy Sprint Pipeline Agent (The Dangerous One)
quests.description: Drafts sprint plans + ClickUp tickets from approved features. Writes to ClickUp on producer approval. Maintains linkage as sprint evolves. THE highest-risk agent — every safeguard matters.
quests.deliverable: Sprint Pipeline Agent running with full approval gates
quests.frictionUnlock: The biggest manual workflow in production — gone. Producers approve breakdowns instead of authoring them. Engineers see fully-contextualized tickets.

quests.title: Expand to Second Pod
quests.description: Roll the proven agent stack (Status Sync, Plan Coherence, Clarity Auditor) to a second pod. Likely Battle or Empire.
quests.frictionUnlock: Proves the pattern scales. Halves the per-agent cost going forward.

chapters.title: Chapter V — Reshape the Rituals
chapters.subtitle: Workflow Redesign
chapters.description: With agents trusted and surfaces live, we audit the meeting schedule and the production rhythm. Cut what's redundant. Reshape what stays.

quests.title: Audit the Meeting Schedule
quests.description: Map every recurring meeting against the goal it serves and the surface that now handles it automatically. Identify cuts, merges, and reshapes.
quests.frictionUnlock: Most meetings exist because information didn't aggregate. Now it does. Reclaim the calendar.

quests.title: Cut Scrum-of-Scrums to 1x/week
quests.description: When dependency map is live and trusted, cut SoS frequency. Re-evaluate if 0x/week is possible after a sprint.
quests.frictionUnlock: First meeting cut. Test case for whether the team trusts the surfaces enough to drop the ritual.

quests.title: Redesign Spec → Shipped Feature Flow
quests.description: End-to-end redesign of the spec → ticket → IC → ship pipeline around the new agent stack. Document the new flow, train the team, measure the delta.
quests.frictionUnlock: This is where the team stops going faster and the *shape* of work changes. The biggest payoff in the campaign.

chapters.title: Chapter VI — IC Augmentation
chapters.subtitle: Per-Discipline Leverage (Parallel Track)
chapters.description: While the org-coordination layer matures, each discipline gets its own AI leverage audit and toolkit. Engineers are partway. The rest is uneven.

quests.title: Engineering Augmentation Audit
quests.description: Where is engineering time going, and where can Claude Code / Cursor / parallel agents remove a chunk? Aim: framework for engineers running 10+ parallel terminals on isolated tasks.
quests.frictionUnlock: The dream state: engineers running parallel agentic work as standard practice. This audit finds the path.

quests.title: Design Augmentation Audit
quests.description: Spec authoring, balance/data analysis, design doc generation. What can designers offload?
quests.frictionUnlock: Designers move faster on iteration; specs reach producers cleaner.

quests.title: QA Augmentation Audit
quests.description: Test plan generation, bug triage, regression prep. What can QA offload to AI?
quests.frictionUnlock: QA stops being a bottleneck on tight sprints; coverage actually improves.

quests.title: Art Augmentation Audit
quests.description: Generative ideation, asset variations, reference gathering — within Fortis policy and craft standards.
quests.frictionUnlock: Artists spend more time on craft, less on production drudgery — within the guardrails.

chapters.title: Final Chapter — The Defeated Boss
chapters.subtitle: What Victory Looks Like
chapters.lockedReason: The end of the road. Defeated when boss HP hits 0.

quests.title: Producer Time Reclaimed: 80% Strategic
quests.description: Calendar audit confirms producers spend 80%+ of their time on strategy and alignment, <20% on plan maintenance.
quests.frictionUnlock: The vision is real.

quests.title: Engineers Running 10+ Parallel Terminals
quests.description: Standard practice, not heroic effort. Framework, skills, and approval gates make this the path of least resistance.
quests.frictionUnlock: The dream state.

quests.title: Meeting Load Cut By Half
quests.description: Total recurring meeting hours per producer cut at least 50% from baseline. Reclaimed time goes to thinking, deciding, aligning.
quests.frictionUnlock: Boss defeated.
